entities.summary: Azriel ibn Menahem ibn Ibrahim al-Tarās also known as Azriel of Girona was the founder of speculative Kabbalah and the Gironian Kabbalist school. He is known for implementing Neoplatonic thought into mainstream kabbalistic tradition.
